function.description: Buy or sell a Trench Express bonding-curve token on Robinhood Chain (4663): a BUY spends ETH to acquire the token; a SELL approves then swaps the token back for ETH. Vex derives a minimum-output floor from a fresh on-chain quote (never zero, never from the caller) and sets the deadline locally. TWO DISTINCT fees apply to the ETH leg and must not be conflated: Trench's own 1% curve fee, taken inside the contract and already reflected in the quote; and Vex's 25 bps (0.25%) fee - on a BUY the ETH you spend, on a SELL the ETH you receive - charged as a SEPARATE transfer that runs only after the trade confirms, so a trade that does not happen is never charged. Spends real funds and is approval-gated - it requires a fresh matching trench__trade_quote first, and a param that drifts from that quote BLOCKS the execute rather than silently re-quoting. Returns one of six named outcomes and never a bare success: `not_attempted` when a pre-sign check refuses, meaning nothing was signed and NO gas was spent, with a failureCode naming the cause (too tight a slippageBps is the common one); `pending` when the broadcast outcome is UNKNOWN, which is recorded and must NOT be retried; `reverted` with failureCode mined_revert when it landed and failed, with the gas spent; `confirmed_pending_amounts` when it settled but the amounts could not be decoded, which are never guessed; `confirmed` on a clean settlement; and `confirmed_unrecorded` when it settled but Vex's own record of it did not land. Pass tokenIn="ETH" + tokenOut=<token> for a buy, or tokenIn=<token> + tokenOut="ETH" for a sell.
function.name: trench__trade_execute

amountIn.description: Human amount of the input token (ETH for a buy, tokens for a sell), e.g. "0.01".

chain.description: Chain - Robinhood Chain / "robinhood" (the only chain; defaults to robinhood).

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (1 bps = 0.01%) for ETH-curve trading on Robinhood Chain; default 100 = 1%, which fits this deterministic, fee-inclusive curve. Pass the SAME value on trench__trade_quote and trench__trade_execute, or omit it on both - a mismatch blocks the execute (the prequote match requires identical params). It is the ONLY price protection on the trade: Vex derives the raw minimum output from a fresh quote at this tolerance (never zero, never from you). A thin or volatile fresh curve token can move between quote and broadcast, so raise it there. A too-tight tolerance USUALLY fails for FREE - the pre-sign gas estimate is refused before anything is signed, NO gas is spent, and the execute returns status "not_attempted" with failureCode slippage; LESS OFTEN the curve moves after that estimate passes and the transaction REVERTS after broadcast, recording mined_revert with the gas SPENT. After either, re-quote with a higher slippageBps and pass the same value. Vex caps it at 1000 (10%) and REJECTS anything above rather than clamping; every increase widens the worst-case price you accept.

tokenIn.description: Input token: "ETH" for a BUY, or the curve token address for a SELL.

tokenOut.description: Output token: the curve token address for a BUY, or "ETH" for a SELL.
